chapter: Meeting Jay McShann and Martin's on the Plaza
title: Meeting Jay McShann at the Taproom and spook breakfasts
summary: Ramey met Jay at jam sessions at the 12th Street Taproom; McShann's rhythm section was Jesse Price and Billy Hadnott.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, now, this is where you met Jay McShann, right?
About that time I met Jay at one of those jam sessions at the Taproom. And --
That was on 12th and Paseo Persaille. And that was one of those walk in off the streets places. All black club, you know.
And was there a piano and drums, or something?

I think they had three pieces there, but when they had the spook breakfasts you know, there'd be a houseful there. And we'd get off of work and we'd find out where the spook breakfast was, and we'd go there, you know. And by this time --
Well, did the breakfasts move from place to place?

Yeah, generally it was. Sometimes they'd have it out there on that highway going out to North Kansas City. There's a place there, I can't think of it now, and I remember so well because they always served meatballs and spaghetti to all the musicians who would come and jam. Because they had a house full of people there at that time of the morning hanging out, and they'd spend lots of money drinking.
Well, when you met Jay in the Taproom (inaudible)
That was just more or less getting acquainted. And naturally, his gang was Jesse Price and Billy Hadnott as far as rhythm section was concerned.
Who was that? Jesse Price and who?
